description: Straight-up, against-the-spread and over/under records for the NFL's special dates since 1999: Thanksgiving (the Lions and Cowboys at home, road teams on a short week, the night game), Black Friday, Christmas Day, international games (London, Germany, Mexico, Brazil, Spain) and the first game back after one, the final regular-season week, and late-season Saturdays. Narrow by team, opponent, home or road, favourite or dog, division, line range or seasons. Answers first with the raw record, n and a 95% interval, then a holds_up block: the last five seasons held out, a false-discovery correction, and an estimate shrunk by how much spots like this actually repeat. Lists the last ten games. For 'Lions on Thanksgiving against the spread', 'how do the Cowboys do on Thanksgiving', 'road teams on Turkey Day ATS', 'Thanksgiving overs', 'Christmas games', 'teams coming back from London', 'Week 18 dogs'.

line_min.description: Side's own line at least this (e.g. 3 = dogs of +3 or more).

team.description: Team: abbreviation, city or nickname, e.g. DAL, Dallas, Cowboys.

name: thanksgiving_and_special_games
title: Thanksgiving, Christmas, international and Week 18 games: how teams really do
